releaseNotes: Release 2.0.7: High-performance C++ Native Engine (vidopro_native) with SIMD multi-threaded pixel processing, C++ real-time color grading & adjustment pipeline (Exposure, Contrast, HSL, 3D LUT, Curves, Sharpen, Blur, Vignette, Grain), C++ 13 blend modes overlay compositor, native audio FFT beat onset detection, and Newton-Raphson Bézier keyframe interpolation.
